kind: design review of someone else's feature request, from measurement

target.title: [Feature]: npm 安装的 Remote 插件支持自动更新
target.state: open with zero comments before ours

whatTheRequestProposed: when the 24-hour check sees npm latest above the installed version, call pluginManager.updateBundle automatically for registry installs

twoTrapsIdentified.trap: latest is not the installable version
twoTrapsIdentified.evidence: 42 minutes after publishing, the mirror served the tarball (302) while its metadata had no such version; an exact pin failed with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION and the bare name resolved an older mature release
twoTrapsIdentified.consequence: the 'behind latest' condition stays true during the window while the update either installs the same version or fails

twoTrapsIdentified.trap: an exact spec is a ceiling
twoTrapsIdentified.evidence: measured across three spec forms; with the cooldown disabled an exact pin still would not move, a caret moved to the highest mature version
twoTrapsIdentified.consequence: market installs write exact versions, so the proposed auto-update would do nothing for exactly the installs it targets

suggestions: compare against the mature version, not latest
skip or rewrite exact specs before updating
align with dshmarket's existing readMinimumReleaseAgeMs / selectMatureUpdate / latestMaturityAt helpers
state the 24-hour expectation in the settings copy
notVerified: whether pluginManager.updateBundle already bypasses the window
whether updateBundle treats an exact spec the way pnpm update does — worth one test against a market-installed plugin
whyThisKindOfContributionMatters: it changes a design before it ships, and it costs the maintainer nothing to accept because every claim comes with a command
